en_title: Wardogs' New Rain System Will Have a Major Effect on Gameplay in Season 2
subtitle: 雷声也能打掩护
opus_summary: 《Wardogs》第二赛季将于10月15日上线，新增全程降雨的雨天对局。雨天会降低能见度，雷声可掩盖枪声；制作人表示，玩家可能喜欢，也可能反感这些变化。

paragraphs.en: Wardogs developer Bulkhead has revealed how rain will change the gameplay in Season 2.
paragraphs.cn: 《Wardogs》开发商Bulkhead透露了第二赛季的雨天将如何改变玩法。

paragraphs.en: Next week, Wardogs will release its second season of content, which will also add rain to the game. This will not be dynamic weather, so don't expect it to be sunshine one minute and storming the next; matches that include rain will experience rainfall the entire time, from start to finish. However, this will result in some major changes to the game, with senior producer Kane Allard confirming to IGN that it "completely changes the game," and as a result, some players may not actually like this addition.
paragraphs.cn: 《Wardogs》将于下周推出第二赛季内容，同时为游戏加入雨天。这并非动态天气，所以别指望前一分钟还晴空万里，下一分钟就暴雨倾盆；雨天对局会从开始到结束一直下雨。不过，雨天会给游戏带来重大变化。高级制作人Kane Allard向IGN确认，雨天会「彻底改变这款游戏」，因此部分玩家可能并不喜欢这项新增内容。

paragraphs.en: "It completely changes the game, and it's going to be positive for some players," said Allard. "It's going to be negative for others. Your play styles might be affected. That's okay. It's not like every map's going to be permanently rain. It's just going to be almost like a different game mode, so to speak. [It] could be that some people really love rain, some people really hate rain based on how you want to play. But it does bring a lot."
paragraphs.cn: Allard说：「它会彻底改变这款游戏，对一些玩家来说是好事，对另一些玩家来说则是坏事。你的打法可能会受到影响，但这没关系。又不是每张地图都会一直下雨。可以说，它几乎就像另一种游戏模式。取决于你想怎么玩，有些人可能会特别喜欢雨天，有些人则可能特别讨厌雨天。但它确实带来了很多变化。」

paragraphs.en: As for how things change, it's pretty drastic. The map is obviously darker, and your visibility is worsened. One developer even stated that he lost his sense of direction on the map because he wasn't used to the way it looked now. The storms will cause thunder, which can be strategically used to mask gunfire or other loud noises. Raindrops will make different sounds based on the surfaces they're hitting, including rooftops and helmets. Windows will also fog up, though it's unclear if that allows players to be less visible when hiding in buildings. The team has also accounted for destruction, meaning if a roof is destroyed, players inside will be exposed to the rain.
paragraphs.cn: 具体来说，变化相当大。地图明显变暗，玩家的能见度也会降低。一位开发者甚至表示，由于不习惯地图如今的样子，他在地图里迷失了方向。暴风雨会带来雷声，玩家可以利用雷声掩盖枪声或其他较大的声响。雨滴落在屋顶、头盔等不同表面上时，会发出不同的声音。窗户也会起雾，但目前还不清楚这是否会让躲在建筑内的玩家更难被发现。团队还考虑到了破坏效果：如果屋顶被摧毁，里面的玩家就会淋到雨。

paragraphs.en: As for other weather effects, Bulkhead isn't ruling anything out, but it has to consider how something like snow would change the game both in terms of gameplay and how the game performs. Bulkhead CEO Joe Brammer stated that there are obvious changes to something like nighttime, which would add flashlights, NVGs, and lasers. Maybe one day we'll get more, but it sounds like it may take some time to get added.
paragraphs.cn: 至于其他天气效果，Bulkhead没有排除任何可能性，但团队必须考虑，下雪等天气会如何影响玩法和游戏运行表现。Bulkhead首席执行官Joe Brammer表示，夜间环境会带来一些显而易见的变化，比如加入手电筒、夜视仪和激光瞄准器。或许有一天我们能见到更多效果，但听起来，这些内容可能还需要一段时间才能加入游戏。

paragraphs.en: We've got plenty more on Wardogs, including Bulkhead on why blue team loses more, a new gambling mechanic for Season 2, and even word of a next-gen port. Wardogs Season 2 launches on October 15.
